split_policy.primary_axis: semantic fixture role before fixture path convenience, diagnostic sidecar, conformance manifest row, report pointer, or retired-surface tag
split_policy.positive_rule: sema positives are hand-authored tests/native/sema fixtures with fixture_kind=positive, canonical_behavior_source=true, and retired_positive_surface=false
split_policy.negative_rule: canonical sema diagnostics are hand-authored tests/native/sema fixtures with fixture_kind=negative and behavior_contract=canonical-rejection; they are rejection behavior, not positive behavior truth
split_policy.docs_evidence_rule: owner index rows, phase contracts, semantic conformance manifests, report pointers, and metadata field names are provenance unless tied to a sema fixture sidecar
split_policy.rejection_rule: old-mode, shim, fallback, generated-only, evidence-log, and migration-only sema rows are rejection or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.omitted_phase_rule: this family has no parser, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e behavior contracts
